content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271, the cardiac event monitoring study ordered for this patient. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9). As the note states, the study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events and guide anticoagulation management."}
